basic_info.description: New Price!!   Welcome to this wonderful top floor, updated Condo at Potrero Court.  This 1 Bedroom, 1 Bathroom unit has been updated with fresh interior paint, new sinks and quartz counters in the kitchen and bathroom as well as new flooring last September. The two large mirrored closets between the bedroom and bathroom give you plenty of space for your personal belongings.  With West facing views of the Eucalyptus trees from the living room and bedroom, you can enjoy your privacy while sitting in your personal space.  The complex is located within walking distance to shopping, transportation and restaurants plus there are some fantastic amenities in the complex such as a heated pool, a spa, a nice gym, a clubhouse with BBQ area and common laundry facilities.  Don't forget about the 1 car parking space in the secure garage area and the complex has earthquake insurance!  Don't miss out on this one!
